name: Blandeau (2011) baseline 10 x 9 CROR, take-off (thesis section 4.2)

info.description: Hypothetical full-scale CROR: 10 x 9 blades, R_t = 2.0 / 1.8 m, R_h = 0.67 m, tip Mach 0.5, flight Mach 0.25. Chord, relative velocity, delta*/c and wake turbulence (w_rms, L) digitised from Figs. 4.4-4.6, wake profile of eqs. 2.12 and 2.78.  Thesis pair as in chapter 4: trailing-edge noise with eq. 3.18 and Rozenberg's model, rotor-wake interaction with eq. 2.73; plus the full formulation (with flight convection).  Fig. 4.7 (sound power): BRTE peaks near 250 Hz, BRWI near 1.6 kHz about 4 dB below it and dominates from ~600 Hz to 6 kHz. Computed with the thesis pair: BRTE peaks at 170 Hz, BRWI at 1.8 kHz, 8.7 dB above it. The difference from Fig. 4.7 is a nearly constant 10-13 dB on the interaction noise; see the README.
info.reference: V. P. Blandeau, 'Aerodynamic broadband noise from contra-rotating open rotors', PhD thesis, ISVR, University of Southampton (2011), section 4.2, Table 4.1 and Figs. 4.4-4.7.

warnings: thesis eqs. 2.73 / 3.18 / 5.7 assume a medium at rest (as in the thesis); flight convection is ignored for those curves
